quality: Typing and pointing feel as they do at the machine
measure: the delay Away adds between a key or a pointer move and its effect on the screen
proposal: under 50 ms, 95 times of 100, with Away and the machine on one network

quality: Text on the machine reads as sharp as on one's own screen
measure: whether a screen at rest is shown exactly, pixel for pixel
proposal: exact within a second of coming to rest, on a high-density screen too

quality: A moving picture stays smooth
measure: pictures a second while a window is dragged, at 1920 by 1080
proposal: 30 or more on a local network; 15 or more on a line of 10 Mbit/s

quality: It stays usable on a slow line
measure: the slowest line on which office work is still possible
proposal: 2 Mbit/s for a desktop; 50 kbit/s for a shell

quality: A machine is on the screen soon after it is chosen
measure: seconds from choosing a machine to its first picture
proposal: under 5 s for a desktop that is running; under 2 s for a shell

quality: A dropped connection costs no work
measure: what a change of network or a closed lid costs
proposal: the session is back by itself within 10 s of the network returning, as it was left

quality: It works in the browser a person has
measure: the browsers and devices every release is tested on
proposal: the current and the previous version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari, on a computer, a tablet and a phone

quality: Every key and shortcut reaches the machine
measure: the key combinations with no way to send them, by browser and keyboard layout
proposal: none: what a browser keeps for itself can be sent from a menu

quality: People who see or hear less can use it
measure: the accessibility level the pages around a session meet
proposal: WCAG 2.2 level AA around the session; a shell a screen reader can read

quality: One sign-in is enough
measure: times a name or a password is asked between opening Away and working on a machine
proposal: none on a Windows machine in a domain and on a shell; none elsewhere once a secret is kept

quality: It works from a device the organisation does not manage
measure: what a device needs besides a browser
proposal: nothing: no app, no certificate, no membership of the domain, no private network

quality: What opens a machine is worth little when stolen
measure: how long a credential made for one sign-in is valid, and where it can be used
proposal: five minutes or less, made for one person and one session, and never sent to the browser

quality: It cannot sign in as the directory's administrators
measure: the accounts Away may sign in as by itself
proposal: none of the directory's privileged groups, unless an administrator names one

quality: A kept secret is never shown again
measure: who can read a kept password or key back
proposal: nobody: not in a page, not through an interface, not in a log

quality: Nobody is watched without knowing
measure: what a person sees while someone else is in their session
proposal: who is there, for as long as they are; joining asks first

quality: The list shows the machines that are really there
measure: the time until a machine added, renamed or removed at its source shows in Away
proposal: 15 minutes for machines taken from a directory; at once for those kept as files

quality: A machine is found in a moment, among hundreds
measure: steps from opening Away to a session on a machine used before
proposal: two: choose it among the last used, and it opens

quality: A person reaches only what a rule gives them
measure: ways to a machine that no rule allows
proposal: none: without a rule a machine is neither shown nor reached, and a test proves it on every change

quality: A right that is taken away is gone at once
measure: the time from removing a right to the end of the sessions that rested on it
proposal: under a minute

quality: No connection is made without a record
measure: connections with no entry in the records
proposal: none: when the record cannot be written, the connection is not made

quality: A record cannot be changed afterwards
measure: who can change or remove an entry, and whether it would show
proposal: nobody inside Away; every entry also leaves Away as it is written

quality: A recording takes little room
measure: the size of an hour of office work, recorded
proposal: under 100 MB for a desktop; under 1 MB for a shell

quality: Someone who has not seen it installs it in an hour
measure: time from nothing to a first session, with a cluster and an identity provider at hand
proposal: one hour

quality: It runs on little
measure: the processor and the memory that 20 desktops of office work take
proposal: 2 processor cores and 2 GiB

quality: A connection that fails says why
measure: the share of failed connections whose message names the step that failed and what to do
proposal: all of them

quality: An update ends nobody's work unannounced
measure: what an update does to the sessions that are open
proposal: people are told before; desktops are back by themselves within 30 s

quality: Whoever runs it learns of a failure before the people do
measure: how a failure reaches them
proposal: a health address and measures for the monitoring that is there, with alert rules ready to use

quality: One failing part does not end everyone's work
measure: what the loss of one instance costs
proposal: its desktops are back on another instance within 30 s

quality: A security hole can be reported in private
measure: a policy that says where and how, and how soon an answer comes
proposal: a policy in the repository, private reports turned on, a first answer within three working days

quality: Every image can be traced to the source it was built from
measure: signatures, a record of each build, a list of what an image holds
proposal: all three, for every release

quality: It rests on little that others wrote
measure: the libraries a release is built from, and which of them speak a remote protocol
proposal: none that speaks RDP, VNC or SSH; every other one listed, licensed and checked on each build

quality: A hostile machine cannot harm Away or the person's browser
measure: how the code that reads what a machine sends is tested
proposal: fuzzed on every change and without pause; reviewed by someone outside before the first release

quality: What is done in a session stays with whoever runs Away
measure: what the pages and the server send to anyone else
proposal: nothing: no fonts, scripts, statistics or update checks from outside

quality: A stranger can change it and have the change taken in
measure: a guide to contributing, and tests that run on every change
proposal: both, with tests against a real server of each protocol
